lines.2: 「Guess I should just stay put and study.」
lines.3: Thanks to the material Konoe gave me, I knew exactly what I needed to focus on.
lines.4: Now I just had to do it.
lines.12: 「Anything in the handouts I gave you yesterday that you don't understand?」
lines.13: 「They're easy to follow. They've been a big help.」
lines.14: 「Good. So you're making progress without any problems.」
lines.16: 「I see. Then I'll let you go.」
lines.17: 「Still, calling just to check on me? That's pretty nice of you.」
lines.18: 「After going that far to help you, I'd feel awful if you still got a failing grade.」
lines.20: 「I'm studying today too, but if there's anything you don't understand, you can call and ask me.」
lines.21: 「I'll be fine. Otome's here. No need to take up your time.」
lines.23: 「Ah, but, you know? Kurogane-senpai is probably studying too. You shouldn't bother her, right?」
lines.24: 「Could say the same thing about you.」
lines.25: 「I lent you the notes and material, so I'm responsible for seeing it through and helping you to the end.」
lines.27: 「All right. If I get stuck, I'll ask you.」
lines.31: 「...Responsible for seeing it through, huh? She really is serious about everything.」
lines.32: Guess I'd better work hard so I didn't disappoint her.
